mentions.name: Peerscope
mentions.description: Peerscope is a competitive intelligence platform for small SaaS teams that can't afford enterprise tools like Crayon or Klue. It provides structured competitor tracking for teams that otherwise have no CI process or rely on one person manually checking competitor websites. The project is also pivoting to include a white-label agency portal, letting agencies deliver competitive intelligence to clients through a branded portal instead of Google Docs or Notion exports. Built on Cloudflare Workers, D1, and R2 with Vite/React 19; a waitlist is open to validate demand.
mentions.problem: Small SaaS teams (5-50 people) actively compete but have no CI process or only one person manually checking competitor websites, while enterprise CI tools are priced at $15K-$20K/year; agencies delivering CI to clients currently rely on Google Docs or Notion exports.
mentions.audience: Small SaaS teams (5-50 people) without a competitive intelligence process, and agencies that deliver competitive intelligence to clients.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Peerscope (https://peerscope-waitlist.pages.dev) — competitive intelligence for SaaS teams who can't justify Crayon or Klue at $15K-$20K/year.
